'''Dryanta''' (meaning "old judge" in [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]]<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>) was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] and cousin of [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. During the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] occupation of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], Dryanta served in the Wookiee resistance under [[Katarra]]. When Chewbacca returned to his homeworld to attend [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawarrump's]] [[Hrrtayyk ceremony/Legends|Test of Ascension]], he left the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] in the care of Dryanta and [[Jowdrrl]], another one of Chewbacca's cousins.

Dryanta participated in the rescue of Han Solo from the [[Intimidator (Executor-class)|''Pride of Yevetha'']]. He was later present at Chewbacca's [[Funeral of Chewbacca|funeral]].
